piezas.titulo: Word reading: Opinions with reasons and examples
texto: Reading and spelling of formal argumentative terms: «ความคิดเห็น» combines the nominalising prefix «ความ» (mid tone), «คิด» (high tone) and «เห็น» (high-class consonant ห in a live syllable, rising tone). «เหตุผล» has «เหตุ» (low tone) and «ผล» (rising tone). «ตัวอย่าง» has «ตัว» (mid tone) and «อย่าง» with อ นํา ย (low tone). «อย่างไรก็ตาม» is a formal five-syllable conjunctive phrase: «อย่าง» (low tone), «ไร» (mid tone), «ก็» (short falling tone) and «ตาม» (mid tone). Reading these expressions helps you structure essays and editorial articles.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การยกตัวอย่างรูปธรรมประกอบคำอธิบายช่วยให้ผู้ฟังเห็นภาพและเข้าใจข้อโต้แย้งได้ชัดเจน» express?

opciones.texto: Illustrating with concrete examples makes the argument clear to the listener.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การยกตัวอย่างรูปธรรมประกอบคำอธิบายช่วยให้ผู้ฟังเห็นภาพและเข้าใจข้อโต้แย้งได้ชัดเจน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Despite differences of opinion, listening with an open mind builds common understanding.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Reason-giving connectives such as «porque» and «por tanto» hold the discourse together.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: In the word «ตัวอย่าง» (example), why is the syllable «อย่าง» pronounced with a low tone?

opciones.texto: Because it has the mid consonant อ leading the low consonant ย (อักษรนำ) with the tone mark ่
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the mid consonant อ makes the low consonant ย behave as a mid-class, which with the mark ่ produces a low tone.

opciones.texto: Because it ends in a stop consonant
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: it ends in the continuous nasal ง (a live syllable).

opciones.texto: Because it has an implicit short vowel a
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: the written vowel is า (a long open vowel).

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
